_metadata.description: Per-destination storage caps that default to alert+block and never silently delete backups.

requirements.title: Per-destination caps with usage accounting
requirements.description: Each destination has a configurable storage cap. Current usage is read from kopia repository stats and compared against the cap, surfaced as within/near/over.

validation.notes: Seed usage; assert within/near/over thresholds computed from repo stats.

requirements.title: Default alert+block, configurable
requirements.description: Over-cap behavior is configurable but defaults to alert+block: alert and refuse new writes rather than evict. Eviction happens only through an explicit retention policy, never silently to stay under a cap.

validation.notes: Drive a destination over cap; assert default blocks new backup + raises alert and does not delete existing snapshots.
